extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: garbage truck (rear loader, 3 axles), approx. 9.1 x 2.5 x 3.5 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 1.04 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the rear loader unit 'garbage-truck_tailgate' (hopper with lifter and riding steps) is a separate object with its origin on the upper hinge axis (rotate around local X, positive angle swings it up and open, approx. 0 to 60 degrees); 6 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the front wheels also steer around local Z; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
